ashby:9fin:f639fa77-e413-45b4-a1a9-7d9d7.summary:
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

sections.title: About 9fin
paras: We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

sections.title: About the role
paras: As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.
This role requires 3 days in our NYC office.

sections.title: What you’ll work on
paras: Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:
bullets: Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.
Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organization.
Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.

Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.
Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.
Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.
Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.
Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

sections.title: About You
bullets: Have 10+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.
Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.
Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.
Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

bullets: Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

Partner with executive leadership to align automation priorities with company-wide product vision and revenue goals.

Define what belongs in the shared platform and what belongs in each product, and keep that boundary clear for the teams building on it.
Build business cases that quantify customer value (hours and dollars saved) and support investment, packaging, and pricing decisions.

ashby:pylon:86e39493-4666-414a-8e1d-45ce.summary:
America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

sections.title: About Pylon
paras: Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.
Join us in building America’s mortgage rails .

sections.title: Role Overview
paras: Pylon is building America's mortgage rails: a vertically integrated, software-driven mortgage platform designed to replace the fragmented wholesale mortgage factory. We are hiring a Head of Account Management to own the broker-facing operating layer around that platform.

This is not simply a mandate to build a larger support organization as volume grows. You will create the systems, service standards, escalation model, and product feedback loops that allow brokers to get excellent support while Pylon continuously removes unnecessary manual coordination from the mortgage process.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the end-to-end broker-facing operational experience.
Define service standards, response-time expectations, escalation paths, and operating cadences.
Build systems for pipeline visibility, broker communication, and issue resolution.
Partner with Processing, Underwriting, Closing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to eliminate recurring friction and handoff failures.
Establish KPIs for service quality, responsiveness, pipeline health, escalations, and manual touches.
Identify which broker problems should be solved operationally and which should become product improvements.
Build and develop the team as needed, without defaulting to headcount as the primary scaling mechanism.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Deep experience in wholesale mortgage operations, ideally in account management or broker operations.
Experience operating at substantially higher loan volume than Pylon handles today.
Demonstrated ability to design and improve operating processes, not simply administer an existing system.
Strong understanding of mortgage workflows and the broker experience.
Excellent judgment, urgency, communication, and cross-functional leadership.
Comfortable working directly with Product and Engineering in a rapidly changing environment.

ashby:relayfi:6f330039-fb85-4745-8345-ef.summary:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

At Relay, product management is about outcomes, not outputs. We start with real customer problems and build solutions that move the needle for SMBs, and for our business. Our team pairs long-term vision with rapid iteration. We believe that trust is a product feature, and that usability, reliability, and polish aren’t afterthoughts, they’re core to how we earn the confidence of business owners.

sections.title: Why this role matters
paras: Many small businesses walk a constant cashflow tightrope, and the average SMB has just 27 days of cash on hand. They’re juggling payroll, inventory, contractor payments, and everyday expenses, all while trying to carve out resources to invest in growth. Product Managers at Relay play a central role in solving these problems by building financial products that are simple, intuitive, and impactful.

As Senior Product Manager, you’ll lead a major product area from end-to-end (e.g. core banking, risk, AI Insights, payroll etc). You’ll take new products and features from zero to one, scale existing ones, and directly impact how thousands of entrepreneurs run their businesses.

sections.title: In your first year, you might:
bullets: Launch and iterate on high priority products ensuring the experiences are simple, intuitive, and trustworthy.
Improve customer outcomes by driving integrations with banking, accounting, or payment platforms.
Collaborate with Risk, Data, and Operations to ensure Relay’s products are reliable, secure, and insight-driven.
Build narratives and roadmaps that align stakeholders, clarify priorities, and inspire confidence, even in the face of ambiguity.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, and CX to deliver successful launches and drive adoption among SMB customers.

sections.title: What You’ll Be Doing:
bullets: Own impactful products end-to-end : define the vision, set the roadmap, and deliver high-impact outcomes shaping how SMBs understand, manage, and spend their money.
Treat your product like a business : define and track KPIs, monitor performance, and make decisions rooted in data, customer insights, and company goals.
Ship high-quality products from ideation to launch : partner closely with design and engineering as part of a leadership trifecta, raising the bar for usability, craft, and polish.
Build and tell the story for your product : create clear narratives that inspire leadership, cross-functional partners, and customers; even in ambiguous situations.

Stay deeply connected to SMB customers : immerse yourself in their workflows and pain points, ensuring we’re solving meaningful problems and delivering products that feel both intuitive and delightful.
Collaborate cross-functionally : work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure smooth go-to-market launches and strong adoption.
Partner externally and internally : navigate and evaluate strategic partners while working across Relay as we grow our product offerings and build new capabilities.
Champion product culture at Relay : bring curiosity, ownership, and a high bar for quality that elevates both the product team as a whole.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: At least five years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping and owning products at scale
Proven ability to take ownership of a product area and influence broader strategy.
Strong data competency with the ability to self-serve metrics and write basic SQL queries to support decision making
Excellent storytelling and communication skills: you bring clarity and inspire conviction across engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
Experience working closely with engineering and design as part of a leadership trifecta to deliver polished, high-quality experiences
Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure effective launches and adoption
Comfort working in ambiguous environments while bringing structure and clarity where needed
Experimental & curious in your approach to product management (i.e. tooling, processes etc)

ashby:rillet:f5fac07f-a10b-4447-ada0-15d.summary:
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. sections.title: Who We Are

sections.title: The Role
paras:

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. sections.title: Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)
bullets: Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity.

Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.

Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.
Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.
Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

sections.title: Run your own sales cycles (~25%)
bullets: Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.
Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.

Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

bullets: Collaboration: Secure, governed channels for institutions to work together on suspected financial crime.
Identity and trust: verified, scoped, and auditable access for institutions and their agents that use Sonar.
Investigation: governed intelligence that connects related entities across institutions.
Distribution: making Sonar available wherever institutions and their agents do their work.
Write and maintain technical specifications, integration playbooks, and documentation for member and partner integrations.
Turn 314(b), GLBA, FCRA, and BSA constraints into product requirements, including purpose limitation, data handling, and audit. Work directly with Legal on implementation questions.
Partner with Engineering on the data and platform architecture that lets Sonar scale.
Work with fraud, AML, and investigations teams at member institutions to understand how analysts work together today.

ashby:sola:10c7e3d9-2594-4d95-a7d8-6c856.summary:

ashby:substack:32cbda9c-7783-45d1-83b9-7.summary: Substack helps independent writers, artists, podcasters, videographers and other creators build sustainable businesses through direct relationships with their audiences. We are building products that give creators more freedom, ownership and ways to earn from their work.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We're looking for a Product Manager to help expand monetization on Substack.

You'll build better ways for readers to support creators and make the experience of paying for great work simpler and more rewarding. Your scope will include gifting, retention offers and improvements to the payment and subscription experience, with opportunities to explore commerce and, over time, advertising-related monetization.

You'll work closely with Payments Engineering, Design, Data, Growth and Creator Product, as well as Chris Chen and the C-level leadership team. You'll develop a clear, data-informed point of view on what to build and advocate for it with conviction, while staying open to evidence and feedback. You'll get close to creators and readers and move comfortably between product strategy and the details of a checkout flow, an offer, an AI-built prototype or an experiment readout.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Identify the most valuable opportunities to improve creator earnings and build a focused roadmap with clear goals and trade-offs.
Develop gifting experiences that help readers support creators, share value with others and strengthen paid communities.
Improve retention, renewal and win-back experiences, partnering with Growth on offers and subscription lifecycle improvements.
Make payment journeys clearer and more effective across web and mobile, from plan selection and checkout through successful payment and renewal.
Explore new monetization pathways, including commerce, and help shape future opportunities in ads as the business evolves.
Use customer research, direct data analysis and rapid AI-powered prototyping to explore solutions and validate ideas before committing engineering time.
Partner with engineering and design to make timely decisions, cut scope to learn sooner and maintain a high bar for product quality.
Define success metrics, run experiments, read results honestly and follow through after launch.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: A record of shipping products that improve meaningful customer or business outcomes, with a clear account of your contribution.

Strategic thinking and strong product judgment: you can use data and customer insight to form an independent point of view, make clear trade-offs and advocate strongly for your recommendations, including with senior leaders, while changing course when evidence calls for it.
Deep curiosity about how creators earn a living and how readers decide what to pay for.
Analytical strength, including funnel and cohort analysis, experimentation and the ability to investigate questions directly.
An AI-native approach to product development: you use AI tools and agents as part of your everyday workflow and can rapidly build working prototypes to test ideas and answer questions yourself.

Strong design taste and product craft: you can recognize and help shape intuitive, polished experiences, with attention to the details that make financial products understandable and trustworthy. You may have developed this judgment at a company known for excellent design or demonstrated it through products you've built.
Clear writing and the ability to align engineering, design, data and business partners around decisions.
Comfort with ambiguity and limited resources, and a willingness to do the detailed work needed to ship and learn.

sections.title: Why this role
paras: The ways people support creators are still evolving. This role offers the chance to improve a core economic relationship on Substack while developing new ways for creators to build durable businesses.

Substack's compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation range for this role is $210,000–$230,000. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise.
Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here .

ashby:substack:fb45e47d-34ef-43c3-a49f-f.summary:
Substack helps independent writers, podcasters, artists, and other creators build businesses around their work. Creators retain ownership of what they publish and build direct relationships with the people who value it.

Our Sponsorships team is building another way for creators to earn, alongside paid subscriptions. We’re looking for a product manager to help brands connect with these communities while preserving publisher choice and reader trust.

sections.title: The Role
paras: You’ll lead product for Substack Sponsorships, from new sponsorship formats and advertiser and publisher tools to the foundations of a scalable marketplace. You’ll partner with Engineering, Design, Data, Partnerships, and the Sponsorships business team to turn early campaign needs into products that serve the broader network.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll spend time with publishers and advertisers, write product requirements, work through design and technical decisions, and ship and iterate with engineers. You should be comfortable moving between business strategy and the details of a sign-up flow, campaign report, or publisher approval experience.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Set the product direction. Use conversations with publishers and advertisers, product data, and company priorities to build a roadmap across near-term experiments and longer-term platform work. Turn lessons from early campaigns into products that work across thousands of publications.

Build distinctive sponsorship experiences. Develop formats that fit naturally into Substack across email, web, and app, including sponsorships that help readers discover writers, access paid work, and become subscribers.

Own the advertiser experience. Make it easy for brands and agencies to discover relevant publications, plan and book campaigns, manage creative approvals, and understand results. Build the path from managed campaigns to self-service buying.

Make sponsorships work for publishers. Create simple tools to opt in, set preferences, approve opportunities, manage placements, and track earnings. Preserve publishers’ control over which brands they work with and how sponsorships appear in their work.

Build the marketplace and operating foundation. Partner with Engineering and Ad Operations on matching, inventory forecasting, campaign delivery, pacing, billing, and payouts. Decide what to build and where external technology or demand partners can accelerate progress.

Prove advertiser value and product impact. Own the measurement roadmap across delivery, reach, engagement, brand lift, and conversion outcomes. Define success metrics, dashboards, and experiments with Data and measurement partners, while respecting reader privacy.

Balance growth with trust. Partner with Policy, Legal, and core Product on advertiser eligibility, sponsorship disclosure, data use, and ad quality. Evaluate revenue opportunities alongside their effects on reader experience and subscription retention.

Own execution and adoption. Partner with your Engineering counterpart to scope, prototype, and ship improvements. Work with the Sponsorships business team on launch plans, product education, and adoption, then use campaign results and customer feedback to decide what to improve next.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
bullets: 10+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of advertising, monetization, or marketplace products and a record of delivering work across teams.
A track record of launching new products and growing adoption and revenue. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs involved, and the results.
A strong understanding of how brands and agencies buy media, how publishers earn revenue, and how campaign delivery and measurement work.
Technical fluency across ad serving, data systems, APIs, and third-party integrations, with the judgment to choose practical solutions for an early-stage business.

Strong product judgment and analytical skills. You can investigate customer behavior, build your own analyses, choose useful success metrics, and interpret experiments. You balance ease of use, commercial needs, and long-term product quality.

High agency and clear written communication. You can make a persuasive case for a priority, write a useful product spec, and explain decisions to technical and commercial partners. You’re willing to work through the details needed to get something shipped.

An understanding of Substack’s product and the needs of its creators and readers. You care about independent publishing and can explain how sponsorships can help creators build sustainable businesses while preserving their relationship with their audiences.

sections.title: Especially relevant experience
paras: Building an advertising business from its early stages; developing self-service buying or publisher monetization tools; working with creator, newsletter, podcast, or subscription businesses; and integrating measurement or programmatic demand partners.

ashby:tessera-labs:d4bcd977-7528-47e1-b9.summary:
Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the speed of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an…

sections.title: Role Summary
paras: We are looking for an SAP Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect to hold the solution direction across several customer engagements at the same time, from the first customer conversation through delivery. This is not a project role, and it is not a consulting role: we are a software platform company.

Two outcomes define the job. The first is that the customer sees value, stated in their terms, agreed in writing, and tracked. The second is that the customer's own teams adopt the Tessera platform as their normal way of working, rather than working around it. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to.

The role also sits partly ahead of delivery in pre-sales. You will join early customer and partner conversations together with the Tessera client partner, because an architect who only sees signed work designs for the problem we solved last year. What you learn there is expected to change how you run the engagements you already hold, and what we ask Product to build next.

sections.title: 1. Solution Direction Across Engagements (35%)
bullets: Own the functional and architectural direction on several concurrent engagements, including the trade-offs between what the customer asked for and what will actually create value.
Orchestrate the engagement team across functional, technical, data and other AI enabled workstreams — you are the person who holds the whole picture when nobody else does.

Translate customer business outcomes into a solution shape the Tessera AI platform can deliver — and say clearly, early, when it cannot. Provide feedback to the Tessera product platform team for new R&D initiatives.
Agree what "better" means with each customer before execution starts: measurable, written, and owned by a named person on their side.

Chronograph was founded to bring next-generation technology to private capital markets. Through our suite of cloud-based analytics and data management solutions, we help many of the world's largest and most sophisticated venture capital, private equity, and credit funds understand their investment performance in unprecedented detail, with over 258,000 private companies and 15,000 private capital funds monitored via our solution suite.

At Chronograph, we get to go "behind the scenes" and work directly with investors who are driving some of the most impactful changes across high growth start-ups, global infrastructure and renewable energy, growth equity, and all other private capital strategies. The firm is backed by Sixth Street Growth, Summit Partners, Carlyle AlpInvest, and Nasdaq Inc., and has seen continuous rapid growth since its founding in 2016. Our client base today includes…

sections.title: Background
paras: Private capital is a multi-trillion-dollar asset class historically run on spreadsheets, where private investment funds and portfolio companies report financials in their own formats on disparate timeframes. Chronograph has 10 years of market-leading experience in extracting, normalizing, reconciling and delivering disparate private markets data at scale: in total, the company manages over $39 trillion in data assets, acting as a central “clearinghouse” of data on behalf of institutional investors. For the company’s Limited Partner (LP) clients, Chronograph’s Data Operations team of New York-based private capital analysts directly oversees the process of collating, extracting, normalizing, and reconciling this enormous dataset across all sub-asset classes within private capital. The team has proven an ability to deliver; we’re now seeking the next level of productivity gains.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We are seeking an analytically rigorous, operationally-minded Product Manager to continue to transform how private capital data is processed at Chronograph. This is a senior role for someone who has a proven track record of transforming technology enabled operations into automated pipelines supplemented by agentic, LLM-native extraction.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you'll work closely with senior leadership, engineering, and applied data extraction teams to own the roadmap for Chronograph's Data Operations processes. You’ll continue to scale the existing systems and processes that convert tens of thousands of GP and fund reporting documents into structured data for many of the world’s leading investors. You'll map and optimize all aspects of the process, quantifying and assessing where agentic processes can run unattended and where data needs human review, setting the confidence thresholds that govern automated reconciliation and matching. You'll redesign how documents are aggregated and organized for the extraction pipeline, cutting manual steps and exploiting the scale that comes from Chronograph's broad coverage of the fund reporting universe. You’ll seek opportunities to expand the scope of data processed by Chronograph, unlocking access to new commercial opportunities, end markets, and asset classes. Ultimately, you'll redefine how data moves between GPs and LPs in private capital markets.

sections.title: As a Product Manager focusing on Fund Administration at Chronograph, you will:
bullets: Transform the Data Operations function : Drive the evolution of Chronograph’s data delivery platform from a technology-supplemented process towards an agent-driven pipeline that automatically handles repetitive tasks to drive increased capacity, timeliness, and efficiency.
Own the roadmap : Develop and maintain a detailed product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on business needs, technical feasibility and resource availability

Re-engineer current processes : Evaluate all aspects of the process, relentlessly ranking and implementing incremental improvement for each touchpoint, particularly where human intervention is required.

Design the routing logic : Build the classification and reconciliation logic that decides which documents clear automatically and which route to a human reviewer, based on accuracy and confidence thresholds, never losing sight that 100% accurate data is the operating minimum in financial services.
Prove efficiency gains with instrumentation : Track throughput and accuracy as the function evolves, tying operational efficiencies to financial objectives, and using that data to steer the roadmap.

Partner cross-functionally : Work closely with Engineering to spec requirements, Design to shape review workflows, and Data Operations leadership to identify known opportunities and drive change management
Be a leader : Manage, develop and motivate a direct report, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment

sections.title: You will be successful in this role if you have:

Deep experience in process evaluation, instrumentation, and optimization, with hands-on knowledge of how technology can be applied to drive productivity and quality.
Demonstrated upskilling in AI and agentically-enabled processes, with continuous learning as a core motivation.

Semi-technical product judgment: you can reason about accuracy and confidence thresholds, decide where automation is safe versus where a human stays in the loop, and write that logic clear enough for engineers to build.
The seniority to own a transformation agenda and to direct a domain expert who supplies the depth on Chronograph’s internal processes.
Comfort in private capital markets, or the ability to get fluent fast in how GPs and LPs exchange fund data.
Strong analytical, project leadership and communication skills.
Positive attitude, sense of humor and creativity.

In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.

A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. Our solutions integrate cameras, radar sensors, AI-powered edge processing, SaaS back-office software, payment systems, and managed maintenance services into end-to-end platforms trusted by government customers. Our vision is to protect lives and increase roadway safety through innovative technology and reliable services and ensure our solutions remain smart, safe, and connected at scale.

sections.title: Position Overview
paras: You’ll evangelize a compelling product vision, coach and empower product teams, and turn real customer problems into scalable, compliant, high-reliability solutions. You’ll stand up and coach empowered product teams—led by Durable Trios of Product, Engineering and Design, spanning hardware, AI, SaaS and services—to solve real customer problems and drive measurable business and customer impact. While you won’t directly own a P&L, your work will move the business - driving sustainable growth, profitability, and customer success.

You will lead the shift from output-focused delivery to business results that matter and drive customer value. You will cultivate deep, real-world understanding of customer needs, and you’ll get teams to engage with customers early and often to test their ideas so that we deliver valuable, viable, usable and feasible solutions.

If you are a strategic leader who thrives on transformation, inspires teams, and delivers measurable impact, this is your opportunity to redefine how we build products and shape the future of mobility.

sections.title: Product Vision & Strategy
bullets: Own and Inspire Product Strategy for Government Solutions : Define and communicate a compelling, insight driven product vision and strategy aligned with the company’s mission, vision, and business goals. Ensure team objectives clearly connect to organizational priorities and desired customer outcomes.
Define the North Star: Craft and champion a unified product vision that brings together a diverse portfolio into a seamless, customer-centric ecosystem.

Shift to Outcome-Based Objectives : Move the organization from sales-driven feature lists to problem-focused, outcome-driven plans. Success will be measured by business outcomes including customer retention, increasing adoption, and driving margin expansion.

Team Topology & Portfolio Strategy : Continuously optimize the Team Topology (organization structure) to minimize dependencies and prioritize opportunities that drive growth and innovation. Sets portfolio and product objectives tied to customer and financial impact.

sections.title: Organizational Transformation & Leadership
bullets: Institutionalize the Product Model: Design an effective Team Topology that fosters cross-collaboration across Product Management, Engineering, and Design as a partnership of missionaries that accelerates cross-functional collaboration and innovation

sections.title: Execution & Delivery
paras: We’re looking for a transformative product leader with a proven track record of driving strategy, execution, and cultural change at scale. The ideal candidate will bring the following capabilities:
bullets: Drive Product Discovery and Delivery : Champion a customer-centered discovery process, working closely with Engineering and Product Design to confront risks early, validate and deliver impactful solutions. Balance innovation with the practical realities of government procurement and compliance.

Manage Business Viability: Balance innovation with the practical realities of government procurement and compliance. You ensure solutions work for our business (legal, sales, finance), not just the user.
Platform Modernization: Collaborate with Engineering to lead the systems migration to modern, microservices-based platforms that increase agility, scalability, and strengthen customer acquisition.

Discovery-First Mindset: Champion a culture of continuous product discovery. Ensure teams validate value, usability, feasibility, and viability before writing code, minimizing waste and maximizing impact.

Customer Focus: Serve as a trusted product leader in conversations with government customers, policymakers, and community stakeholders. Champion discovery and continuous learning to ensure products address real-world needs.

Outcome-Driven Governance: Oversee the Quarterly Product Business Review process to provide transparency into product health, strategic alignment, outcome metrics, data-driven insights and share learnings on what is and isn't working.

We’re passionate about…

sections.title: About the role
paras: WEKA is looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and go-to-market for Augmented Memory Grid (AMG), part of the NeuralMesh platform. This is a deeply technical PM role sitting at the intersection of AI inference infrastructure, high-performance networking, and enterprise storage. You will work directly with engineering, GPU/inference partners (NVIDIA, hyperscalers, GPU clouds), and enterprise customers running large-scale LLM inference to define what AMG needs to do next.

sections.title: Bring Your Expertise – and Your Passion
bullets: Strategic Vision : You are a strategic thinker who can develop and execute product strategies that align with market trends and customer needs, as well as think critically about existing strategies. You have a proven ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and deliver results.

Communication Skills : You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable presenting product strategies and roadmaps to internal teams and external customers.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Own the AMG product roadmap: KV-cache/prefix-cache offload, memory tiering, and integration with inference engines and orchestration layers (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Kubernetes-based serving).

Partner with engineering to define architecture trade-offs across GPU memory, networking (RDMA, GPUDirect, NVMe-oF), and distributed storage — translating inference performance bottlenecks (time-to-first-token, throughput, context length) into product requirements.

Work directly with enterprise customers and GPU cloud partners: Nebius, CoreWeave, TogetherAI, etc., running production inference workloads to gather requirements, validate benchmarks, and prioritize features that reduce cost-per-token and improve SLAs at scale.
Partner with NVIDIA and other silicon/inference-stack partners on joint roadmap and certification work.
Define and track benchmarks (TTFT, throughput, cache hit rate) that demonstrate AMG's value versus standard GPU-memory-only inference.
Support sales and field teams with technical positioning, competitive differentiation, and enterprise deal support.

sections.title: Must-have qualifications
bullets: Inference ecosystem depth: hands-on product or engineering experience with LLM inference serving — vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Ray Serve, or comparable — and fluency in concepts like KV-cache, prefix/context caching, quantization, and batching strategies.

Model & systems familiarity: working knowledge of how modern LLMs are served in production (context windows, multi-tenant serving, GPU scheduling) well enough to translate model-level constraints into infrastructure requirements.

Networking/infrastructure fluency: comfort with the fundamentals of high-performance networking and distributed systems — RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, NVMe-oF, or equivalent — and how they affect inference performance.
Enterprise customer experience: track record working directly with large enterprise accounts — requirements gathering, production deployments, SLAs — not solely self-serve/PLG products.
10+ years of product management experience, ideally with some portion in infrastructure, ML platforms, or developer-facing technical products.
